apis.name: canvas-readback
apis.customReason: Deterministic Window Canvas and accessible OffscreenCanvas ImageData/PNG readback projection, including covered export methods. sparse-rgb-v1 (default) changes one RGB level in about 1% of fully opaque pixels; stable-rgb-v1 changes every fully opaque pixel by one level and is kept for older profiles. Native drawing, WebGL readPixels and workers are unchanged. Readbacks above four megapixels are denied rather than returned unchanged.

apis.name: webrtc
apis.customReason: IP overrides change JavaScript metadata; network routing is controlled separately.
